lines.t: Make the Way Straight
Yeah, yeah, yeah
Thou says the Lord to the peoples of the earth
In my right hand the power to birth
In my left hand judgment and flame
I am he, the engine of days, the great I am
The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
Whose name is Israel, none can shake him
I said my only begotten, the word became flesh
Yahushua, Mena, El, righteousness and breath
He came once in mercy, comes again in power
Every knee will bow, every nation will cower
The Holy One returns, the trumpet sounds
The Lord of hosts is heaven bound
Make the way straight, prepare His path, don't wait
If the lion will roar, call His name, be restored
Make the way straight, prepare His path, don't wait
If the lion will roar, call His name, be restored
Ahead came John, the voice in the wild Crying out, repent, the spirit compiled
Trumpet in hand, water and word Baptized the broken, spoke what he heard
Now on the fourth, four thousand lives in the land Fire in their voices, trumpet in hand
Spirit of Elijah, thunder in their breath Preparing the way, defying death
Witnesses walking with tongues aflame Bearing his name, not seeking fame
Judgements fall, foundations quake The pride of man the Lord shall break
Cities fall, towers bend Desolation sweeps, yet there's hope in the end
Call upon Yahushua, call and be saved The Lamb who conquered the grave
Yet the sanctuary in the storm, a way of escape has been formed
He is the Christ, Yahushua by name, call upon Him, be free from shame
Make the way straight, prepare His path, don't wait
We shall have our sea, if the lion will roar, call His name, be restored
Take the way straight, prepare His path, don't wait
You shall hide my seeds, the lion will roar
Call His name, be restored
Call upon Him in truth
And you shall surely be delivered
Says the Lord
Thank you.
